flagged.title: Break-even
flagged.reason: The video prominently states and displays as a key rule that every unit sold above break-even is 'pure profit', reinforcing a classic GCSE misconception where students ignore variable costs on units sold past break-even.

mark_affecting.quote: Every unit sold above the break-even point is pure profit.

flagged.title: Ethical & Environmental Considerations
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims that the Advertising Standards Authority can issue heavy fines (it has no fining powers) and that Costa Coffee sells only Fairtrade coffee (its coffee is Rainforest Alliance certified, not Fairtrade).

mark_affecting.quote: regulators like the Advertising Standards Authority in the UK will step right in and slap you with some really heavy fines.
Brands like Costa Coffee and Greggs intentionally accept the higher cost of selling only Fairtrade coffee in their UK cafes
